name: Banh bot loc
summary: Bánh bột lọc, also listed as bánh lọc, is one of the small steamed cakes Da Nang serves with bánh bèo, bánh nậm, and bánh xèo. Con Market puts bánh bột lọc on the outdoor counters.
origin: Da Nang, with the small steamed cakes.
howToEat: In Da Nang, order it with the other small steamed cakes.

In Dong Hoi, Du khách on 15 Mar 2023 says the cake is cassava flour, filled with shrimp, ground pork, mushroom, and bamboo shoot, eaten hot, plain or in a banana leaf. The ward office and Du khách on 29 May 2024, crediting VCT News, name a third form, fried. The 15 Mar 2023 article does not mention the fried cake. Du khách on 31 Oct 2024, republishing Dân Việt, says fresh cassava flour, shrimp, pork, wood-ear, and mung bean, wrapped in banana leaf. All of those lines stay. The price is Check on arrival.
where: An ordinary Da Nang restaurant groups bánh lọc with bánh bèo, bánh nậm, and bánh xèo. Bánh bột lọc is on the outdoor counters at Con Market.

In Dong Hoi the cake is on Lê Thành Đồng and Đồng Hải. Du khách on 20 Mar 2017, republishing VnExpress, also describes bánh mì kẹp bột lọc at Chợ Đồng Hới: hot bread filled with shrimp cakes and mung-bean cakes, plus a hot sauce. Hours are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh bot loc — steamed cakes in Da Nang
seoDescription: Bánh bột lọc is a small steamed cake Da Nang serves with bánh bèo and bánh nậm, including on Con Market’s outdoor counters.
